findings.summary: A build with no backend (web leg, PHYSX=OFF and JOLT off) now logs an ERROR on every start because the hosts' PHYSX request is 'refused'; before it was an Info 'Built without PhysX'
findings.scenario: Web player with a default project: host option PHYSX, nothing built -> ChooseBackend refused=true -> Logger::Error and Physics row text 'No physics: the host option ... is physx ... no physics backend'; noisy and an error-level line for a supported configuration (docs describe it, behaviour is deliberate but worth the user's acceptance)
